 NBA Star Shai Gilgeous-Alexander Brings the Heat as Spotify’s First Guest Editor
 November 12, 2026
 Share 
 Share 
 Oklahoma City Thunder star Shai Gilgeous-Alexander has already racked up an impressive list of accomplishments, including two NBA MVP awards and one championship ring. Now, the star point guard is taking his talents beyond the court , making history as Spotify’s first-ever guest editor on our new playlist, Heat Check by SGA . 
 Launching today, Heat Check serves up 50 tracks handpicked by Shai, spotlighting both big names and rising artists. He’ll update the playlist monthly, giving fans an ongoing look at what’s in his rotation. It joins editorial playlists like RapCaviar , Taste , and Today’s Top Hits , all designed to introduce listeners to the artists and sounds shaping culture today. 
 “People can expect versatility,” Shai said of his plans for the playlist. “Music for every vibe, every part of the day, every mood, and above all, just really good music.” 
 To celebrate the moment , Spotify is releasing an exclusive interview with the Thunder guard, where he shares his earliest musical memories, longtime favorites, and the songs he can’t stop playing right now. 
 And that’s not the only time we’ll hear from Shai this month. Ahead of the 15 th anniversary of Drake ’s Take Care , we asked the basketball star to reflect on the album’s impact on hip-hop and what it’s meant to him personally. Stay tuned—that video, and more content from our partnership with Shai, is coming soon. 
 Stream Heat Check by SGA on Spotify now.
